```sql
WITH orders_2025 AS (
  SELECT order_id, order_cost
  FROM "jaffle_shop"."dev"."orders"
  WHERE ordered_at >= '2025-01-01' AND ordered_at < '2026-01-01'
),
revenue_2025 AS (
  SELECT oi.order_id, SUM(oi.product_price) AS revenue
  FROM "jaffle_shop"."dev"."order_items" oi
  WHERE oi.ordered_at >= '2025-01-01' AND oi.ordered_at < '2026-01-01'
  GROUP BY oi.order_id
)
SELECT
  SUM(r.revenue) - SUM(o.order_cost) AS gross_profit_2025,
  (SUM(r.revenue) - SUM(o.order_cost)) / SUM(r.revenue) AS gross_margin_pct_2025
FROM orders_2025 o
JOIN revenue_2025 r ON o.order_id = r.order_id;
```
